Title: New generation of D-Series instances in Brazil South

Body.Content:
The new generation of D-Series instances is now available for Azure Virtual Machines and Azure Cloud Services in Brazil South. These Dv2 instances carry the same CPU, memory, and disk configurations as the current D-Series, but they offer more powerful CPUs and run about 35 percent faster. Both D-Series and Dv2 instances are ideal for applications that demand fast CPUs, better local disk performance, or larger memories—a powerful combination for many enterprise-grade applications.

For more information, please visit the Virtual Machines and Cloud Services pages. For more information about pricing, please visit the Virtual Machines pricing and Cloud Services pricing pages.
